platform: Cloud-native browser-based K–12 SIS with responsive Alma Now mobile portal; state deployments may be Alma-hosted, agency-hosted, or hybrid.

distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Surfaces attendance, grades, behavior, family engagement, assessment, and data-quality patterns for earlier school intervention.
Supports state collection, validation, certification, and school-to-agency data exchange, including New Hampshire's iNHDEX.
Lets schools discover connectors, configure data sharing, and monitor integrations across learning, communications, and administrative systems.
Enables validated bulk edits and imports, reducing repetitive record maintenance for school administrators.
Tracks implementation tasks such as GPA setup, schedules, and LMS integrations during school onboarding.
Supports proficiency calculations, rubrics, mastery tracking, and standards-based report cards within the SIS.

weaknesses.issue: Pricing is quote-only, with no published subscription, module, implementation, or payment-fee rates.
Complex reporting may require CSV workarounds and can be difficult to customize.
Reviewers report occasional glitches, technical difficulties, and workday-impacting downtime.
Some users report time-consuming standards grading and gradebook synchronization, saving, or viewing issues.
Some reviews describe slow support follow-up or trial-and-error when resolving difficult issues.
Transport, library, hostel, inventory, payroll, and full special-education workflows are not documented as native modules.
A current independent security audit, hosting regions, and SOC 2 or ISO certification were not verified.

ai_features: BeaconAI provides analytics on chronic absence, D/F trends, family disengagement, behavior patterns, assessment gaps, and data quality.
Predictive analysis is described, but no conversational assistant or generative AI feature was verified.
pricing_model_summary: Custom quote; no public prices or free trial. Subscription terms and fees are set in a separate written agreement; some capabilities are upgrades.
biggest_strategic_gap: Limited native breadth beyond core K–12 SIS: several operational specialties depend on integrations, while complex reporting and pricing transparency are concerns.
